jobs.prompt: Opus review of the local probe change (PASS with two medium findings): (1) tools/local-lane.mjs healthCache.set(item.name, item.reachable) marks an endpoint healthy on 401, 403, 404 or 405, including a 403 or 404 from an unrelated service or proxy on that port, and a 401 after --verify-key already showed the key is wrong. Fix: when keyStatus is rejected set the cache to unhealthy; count only 401 and 403 as 'up, wants a key' (drop 404 and 405 from reachable so an unrelated service is not treated as a model server), and when a keyed verification succeeded (2xx) mark it verified. Also make the router's sensitive-job rule (tools/router.mjs and the executor guard in tools/api-adapters.mjs) depend only on the endpoint's loopback host and never on the health result: add a test that a sensitive job is never routed to a non-loopback endpoint even when health says reachable. (2) verifyLocalEndpointKey must itself refuse before reading the key, returning key-blocked and sending nothing, unless the endpoint baseUrl is https or a loopback http address (127.0.0.1, [::1], localhost); add a test with a non-loopback http endpoint proving the Keychain reader is never called and no request is made. Update docs/local-lane.md. Keep all local lane, tunnel and router tests passing.
jobs.ignoreTestsReason: local lane and router tests in context; full suite before merge
